canary_sampling: balanced per attack cohort; SystemRandom shuffle; private schedule never persisted
noise_sampling: fresh OS randomness in the shipped release kernel

decoders.status: guess 1 iff kind is error, otherwise 0
decoders.score: count categories 0 and 1 across both axes; larger count wins; uniform seeded tie; absent verdict is a seeded tie

axis_meaning.deception: hidden-test pass bucket: raw 3 for pass, 0 for fail
axis_meaning.sycophancy: declared function signature: raw 3 for match, 0 otherwise

honest_estimator: per axis: mean(released bucket) - 1; pass rate is the first axis
honest_interval: Hoeffding radius sqrt(9*ln(40)/(2*n)); difference radius sqrt(9*ln(40)*(1/n_A+1/n_B)/2); retain untruncated intervals
scope: fixture agent, not a learned model
timing_deviation: A 0.5-second window rejects the required integer 2-second bundle limit. User approved window 2.5, lead 2.55, and 128 attack trials before execution.
reporting: One full reported run; preserve every interrupted output directory; never rerun for nicer numbers. Utility separation and runtime are observations, not guaranteed outcomes.
